contract.interface:
Source-reported computational candidate: for an n-qubit H_X(t)=H_0+sum_(a=1)^r X_a(t)A_a with arbitrary Hermitian noncommuting supplied operators, independent stationary classical OU and/or symmetric telegraph modes, and an input initially independent of the noise, implement the complete noise-averaged channel to diamond error epsilon. With p supplied instruments at prescribed times, adaptive choices based on retained outcomes are allowed, uniformly over controllers unable to inspect the private seed. This is a derived unreviewed construction, not a demonstrated quantum circuit, physical quantum-bath model or universal speedup.

OU modes have dX=-lambda X dt+sqrt(2lambda)dW and covariance exp(-lambda|t-s|), with lambda=0 a static Gaussian. Telegraph modes switch at lambda/2 and have the same covariance, but their joint laws differ. Physical amplitudes belong in A_a. Actual controlled, inverse and indexed implementations of H_0/alpha_0 and A_a/alpha_a, parameter acquisition, selection, coefficient loading and finite precision are charged in C_sel(b). Set S=sum alpha_a and action Acal=1+p+T(alpha_0+S). The proposed gate bound is O-tilde(Acal C_sel+Acal^2)+C_ctrl, hiding fixed polynomials in parameter bits and logarithms of r+2, 1+lambda_max T, 1+Acal and 1/epsilon, with no grid-size power. It does not promise preparation of a full density matrix or fine trajectory.

On M=2^m grid cells, stationary OU endpoints and conditional midpoints are generated by a binary bridge. For half-width h and a=exp(-lambda h), X_mid=a(X_left+X_right)/(1+a^2)+sqrt[(1-a^2)/(1+a^2)]Z_node. Opposite telegraph endpoints give an unbiased midpoint; equal endpoints x give -x with probability (1-a)^2/[2(1+a^2)]. A queried value visits at most m+2 innovations, consistently addressed by mode/tree node, with stable Gaussian recursion 2a/(1+a^2)<=1. This constructs joint laws, not merely covariance; classical virtual Brownian trees are credited prior work.

For coupled paths, diamond error <=2 integral sum alpha_a E|X_a-Y_a| dt, including instruments before conditioning. Let C_G=sum_G alpha_a sqrt(lambda_a), C_R=sum_R alpha_a lambda_a and Delta=T/M. Left-grid error <=2sqrt(2)T sqrt(Delta)C_G+2T Delta C_R. A sufficient grid has M>=C[1+T^3 C_G^2/epsilon^2+T^2 C_R/epsilon], plus M>=C Lambda T(1+p/epsilon) for segmentation/control rounding. The huge grid is represented by log M bits. Finite Gaussian quantiles use antisymmetric rounding, truncation and polynomial-bit inverse-CDF evaluation with mean-zero squared approximation error <=eta^2; unit l2 coefficient sums keep each grid-value error bounded by eta. Finite telegraph thresholds charge log(rM/epsilon) bits without visiting all nodes. A final deterministic Gaussian cap B=ceil(sqrt[2log(64(1+ST)/epsilon)]) gives Lambda=alpha_0+B sum_G alpha_a+sum_R alpha_a. All channel-error estimates are first proved under fully independent innovations.

For piecewise constant cells in a segment d, the ordered k-fold Dyson integral equals d^k/k! times the expectation of the sorted-cell product, including repeated cell indices; no noise differentiability is assumed. Established truncated-Dyson simulation, uniform binary time registers, reversible sorting and oblivious amplification yield q=O[(1+p+Lambda T)log((1+p+Lambda T)/epsilon)] Hamiltonian calls. Padded intervals do not advance the physical noise clock. Including bridge computation and uncomputation gives a fixed innovation-query bound Q=8q(m+2), chosen before the seed family, avoiding a random-budget circularity.

The established bounded-query replacement lemma, also proved in the report by degree-2Q output-density polynomials, says a Q-query quantum circuit has exactly the same averaged output channel under a 2Q-wise independent uniform innovation function as under a fully independent table. It retains references and measurement records, but does not approximate the complete path distribution. A degree-(2Q-1) polynomial over F_(2^b) supplies the function on D=O(r(M+1)) addresses. Uniform coefficient registers remain private; reversible Horner evaluation costs O(Q poly(b)) per call and O(Q^2 poly(b)) total, with O(Qb) seed/workspace. A deterministic quadratic field tower with trace-one elements pays finite-field construction. Scratch is uncomputed so it leaks no extra information outside the query model. Short-seed values need not be globally Gaussian or Markovian; exact circuit-output equality is applied only after the independent-law approximation proof.

Precision b=O[B_in+m+log((r+2)(q+1)(1+ST)/epsilon)] is rounded to a power of two with enlarged arithmetic/synthesis constants. The explicit gate cost is O[q C_sel(b)+Q^2 poly(b)]+C_ctrl, workspace n+O(q a_sel+Q poly(b))+W_ctrl. Coefficient reading, selector compilation and expanded circuit output are charged. For O(n) bounded-locality terms/modes a scan selector costs O(n poly(b)); at T=O(1/J), sigma=O(J), p=O(n), the proposed bound is O-tilde(n^2)+C_ctrl. No QRAM or fine-noise array is assumed. This is a many-body workload, not an exponential advantage inferred from a single-excitation state space.

The same seed persists through interventions, retaining outcome-conditioned future noise memory. With coherent input preparation/inverse cost C_in and bounded effect implementation cost C_F, additive-delta estimation costs O-tilde[(G(delta)+C_in+C_F)delta^-1 log(1/zeta)]; copies-only access instead incurs delta^-2 sampling. Bell preparation/readout for control entanglement fidelity costs O(n) plus the ideal control/inverse. Amplitude estimation acts on the already compiled accurate circuit, not an unlimited noise service. Tiny conditional outputs and full classical tomography remain separately charged.

Competent comparators are explicit: amplitude encodings of stochastic paths are not free coherent binary-value oracles; Gaussian pseudomodes may be preferable and do not automatically reproduce non-Gaussian telegraph laws. Telegraph noise has an exact r-qubit Markovian embedding with H_ext=H_0+sum A_a tensor Z_a and L_a=sqrt(lambda_a/2)X_a, with general normalized Lindblad time T(alpha_0+S+sum lambda_a/2). The candidate trades quadratic Hamiltonian action for removal of leading switching-rate cost in its uniform upper bound. Moderate rates or certified fast-noise averaging can favor specialized methods. No lower-bound separation or superiority over all specialized algorithms is proved.

Independent signs and (a,b,ab) have identical one/two-variable marginals but three commuting sign pulses give order-one channel discrepancy; resetting a static Gaussian each cell removes dephasing; a short-seed full table can be far from the independent law; and fixed integrated white-noise strength makes amplitudes grow as sqrt(lambda). These failures delimit the operation. Prescribed classical noise is not a finite-temperature quantum bath with backreaction/detailed balance. Parameter learning, hardware-oracle certification, full circuit execution and formal verification remain absent. The exact prompt/process/report and recovered citation targets are preserved without repairing the pasted source. Reported small diagnostics are not independent general-proof or priority evidence. Earlier N701/N704 investigations are retained conversation capital, explicitly not proof premises; the exploratory impurity-spectroscopy remark is process history, not a promoted separate discovery.

failed_attempts.attempt: Match covariance instead of the full queried joint law
failed_attempts.failure_scope: Independent signs and (a,b,ab) agree pairwise but three commuting pi/4 sign pulses give coherence factors 0 and i. Exact finite-query independence is stronger than covariance agreement.

failed_attempts.attempt: Redraw a private seed after each control or time cell
failed_attempts.failure_scope: For static Gaussian dephasing the coherence changes from exp(-2 sigma^2 T^2) to exp(-2 sigma^2 T^2/M), tending to one. Persistent environmental memory is essential.

failed_attempts.attempt: Use the seed as a full path sampler or unlimited oracle
failed_attempts.failure_scope: A 2Q-wise polynomial table need only match the fixed Q-query circuit; full table distributions may have nearly maximal total-variation discrepancy. All scratch/seed information must stay private and query costs must be fixed before seed selection.

failed_attempts.attempt: Remove switching-rate cost while holding white-noise intensity fixed for free
failed_attempts.failure_scope: At fixed integrated OU strength, amplitude grows as sqrt(lambda); the Hamiltonian-action resource S grows. Logarithmic rate dependence at fixed amplitude is not a free white-noise limit.
